title: DOH AUTHORIZES REOPENING OF BLAZIN STEAKS – MILILANI SHOPPING CENTER
summary: HONOLULU — The Hawai‘i Department of Health (DOH) Food Safety Branch (FSB) issued Blazin Steaks – Mililani Shopping Center a green placard and authorized its reopening. Inspectors found at the follow-up inspection that the establishment had sufficient cold holding units to maintain potentially hazardous time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods at 41 F or colder.
